primary_category.subcategory: A2.4 Information search, retrieval, gathering, and evaluation

evidence.quote: I focused my initial workup on Meridian and its immediate corporate web — pulling registry filings, past KYC refresh notes, that kind of thing.
evidence.explanation: The core activity is gathering, comparing, and filtering records (registry filings, KYC notes, vendor reports, SWIFT messages) to build a case, which is the defining feature of information search/evaluation.

evidence.quote: I didn't go back and independently re-verify that specific entity-matching step before folding the report into the case file.
evidence.explanation: Evaluating and verifying (or failing to verify) externally sourced evidence before incorporating it into a case file is a direct instance of information evaluation.

evidence.quote: We'd requested SWIFT records — MT202 and MT103 messages — to confirm the fund flow to the suspected end-user.
evidence.explanation: Requesting and awaiting specific financial records to corroborate a hypothesis is a retrieval/evaluation task central to the case.

evidence.quote: figure out whether this was probable sanctions evasion
evidence.explanation: Forming a diagnostic theory (sanctions-evasion typology) from disparate facts about invoices, ownership, and registry links requires building an abstract causal model, not just retrieving facts.

evidence.quote: the registered-agent match jumped out immediately. That pattern had been reliable before — same agent, similar shell structure, same region.
evidence.explanation: Recognizing and generalizing a typology pattern from a prior case to the current one reflects abstraction/pattern generalization.

evidence.quote: I held off drafting it. I figured the records would probably come through in time — I wanted the file to be complete with that corroborating piece rather than submit something with a gap in it.
evidence.explanation: Deciding whether and how to sequence escalation drafting against an external dependency and deadline is a planning/contingency task involving timing and resource tradeoffs.

evidence.quote: With reconciliation, narrative drafting, and compliance sign-off left, I estimated two business days.
evidence.explanation: Sequencing remaining tasks and estimating timing toward a filing deadline is a planning activity.

evidence.quote: Comparable cross-border verification cases have typically run five to seven days.
evidence.explanation: Comparing numerical time estimates against historical durations involves quantitative reasoning, though it is secondary to the qualitative planning judgment.

evidence.quote: My team lead actually asked why it wasn't in my initial scoping note.
evidence.explanation: The episode involves coordination with a team lead and junior analyst regarding priorities, review, and case handoff, though the participant is more the coordinated party than the coordinator in this episode.
